simple.meaning: סָבִיב (çâbîyb) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “(as noun) a circle , neighbour , or environs ; but chiefly (as adverb, with or without preposition) around.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 337 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 5 more, beginning at Genesis 23:17. Its contexts include family line, city, land, mountain, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to סָבִיב (H5439).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: סָבִיב (çâbîyb) / H5439 is traced through Genesis 23:17, Genesis 35:5, Genesis 41:48, Exodus 7:24 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.short: (as noun) a circle , neighbour , or environs ; but chiefly (as adverb, with or without preposition) around
definitions.usage: (place, round) about, circuit, compass, on every side.
definitions.full: H5439. sabib or sebibah סָבִיב 336 substantive , used mostly as adverb and preposition , circuit, round about : — construct סְבִיב Amos 3:11 ; plural construct סְבִיבֵי Jer 32:44 ; 33:13 , suffix סְבִיבֶיךָ etc. (10 t.), much oftener סְבִיבוֺת Exod 7:24 22 t., תֶיךָ סְבִיבוֺתַי, -, etc., Deut 17:14 , etc. (48 t.): — 1 in singular — a. as substantive 1Chr 11:8 וְעַדהַֿסָּבִיב מןהֿמלוא and to the parts round about . b. as adverb accusative סָבִיב (in) a circuit , i.e. round about , Gen 23:17 סָבִיב בְּכָלגְּֿבֻלוֺ Exod 19:12 ; 25:11 , 24 , 25 ; Lev 1:5 , 11 סָבִיב הַמִּזְבֵּחַ עַל , Judg 20:29 ; 1Kin 3:1 ; 5:11 ; Psa 3:7 ס ׳אֲשֶׁר עָלָ֑י שָׁתוּ , Psalm 12:9; 34:8 + often; sometimes doubled, for the sake of emphasis, 2Chr 4:3 ; Ezek 8:10 ס הַקִּיר ׳עַל ׳ס , 37:2 ; 40:5 and often in Ezekiel 40-43. c. as preposition : ( a ) Psalms, Amos 3:11 הָאָרֶץ וּסְבִיב צַר distress , and that in the circuit of (= round about ) the land (but read probably with יְסֹבֵב ᵑ6 will encircle ). ( b ) לְ ׳סָבִיב Exod 16:13 ; 40:33 ; Num 1:50 , 53 ; 2:2 ; Judg 7:21 ; 1Kin 6:5 ; 18:32 , 35 ; Ezek 41:10 ; 14:16 ; Job 19:12 ; Psa 34:8 ; 78:28 ; 125:2 (twice in verse) ׳י לְעַמּוֺ סָבִיב , 128:3 ; Song 3:7 ; Nahum 3:8 . ( c ) strangely, אֵת סָבִיב 1Kin 6:5 (omitted by ᵐ5 ), Ezek 43:17 . d. מִסָּבִיב 42 , from round about, from every side , Ezek 16:33 , 37 ; 23:22 ; 37:21 , but usually ( מִן 1c ) = on every side , Jer 4:17 מִסָּבִיב עָלֶיהָ הָיוּ , Isa 42:25 מ ׳וַתְּלַהֲטֵהוּ , Joel 4:11; Joel 4:12; Psalms מִסָּבִיב מָגוֺר terror on every side ! Jer 6:25 ; 20:3 , 10 ; 46:5 ; 49:29 ; Psa 31:14 , compare Lam 2:22 ; especially in the Deuteronomic phrases מ ׳אוֺיְבִים , or מ ׳הֵנִיחַ (sometimes in combination), as Deut 12:10 מ מכלאֿויביכם לכם ׳והניח , 25:19 ; Josh 21:42 י ׳וַיָּנַח מ ׳לָהֶם , 23:1 ; Judg 2:14 ; 8:34 ; 1Sam 12:11 +; לְ מִסָּבִיב from round about , Num 16:24 , 27 . — On 1Sam 14:21 ; 2Sam 24:6 ; Job 10:8 see סָבַב . 2 In plur.: — a. סְבִיבִים : ( a ) in masculine sense, those round about , Psa 76:12 שַׁי יֹבִילוּ כָּלסְֿבִיבָיו , 89:8 ; Jer 48:17 , 39 . ( b ) in neuter sense, the parts round about , 49:5 ירושׁלם בִּסְבִיבֵי מִכָּלסְֿבִיבָ֑יִךְ, 32:44 ; 33:13 ; 21:14 כָּלסְֿבִיבֶיהָ וְאָֽכְלָה , 46:14 ; with the force of a perp. , Psa 50:3 מאד נשׂערה וסביביו , 97:2 ; Lam 1:17 . b. סְבִיבוֺת ( a ) as substantive ( α ) circuits , Eccl 1:6 הָרוּחַ שָׁב סביבותיו ועל ; ( β ) the parts round about , Num 22:4 אתכֿלסְֿבִיבֹתֵינוּ הקהל ילחכו , Jer 17:26 ; 50:32 (compare 21:14 above); with reference to their inhabitants, Psa 44:19 = 79:4 לסב וקלס ׳לעג , Ezek 16:57 ; 28:24 ; Dan 9:16 . ( b ) with the force a preposition Exod 7:24 הַיְאֹר סְבִיבֹת literally (in) the circuits of the Nile = round about the Nile, Num 11:24 , 31 , 32 ; 35:2 סְבִיבֹתֵיהֶם , Judg 7:18 ; 1Sam 26:5 , 7 ; 2Kin 6:17 אלישׁע סביבֹת , Psa 18:12 ; 27:6 סביבותי אֹיְבַי על , etc.; often idiomatic preceded by אשׁר , as Gen 33:5 סביבותיהם אשׁר הערים 41:48 ; Lev 25:44 ; Num 16:34 ; Deut 6:14 ; 13:8 ; 17:14 ; 21:2 +. In the same sense מִסְּבִיבוֺתָם Ezek 28:26 .
